name: Loopback Web Lab
summary: Test up to 20 simple path names on your own local server at 127.0.0.1:8080. One worker, two requests/second, 20-second limit. Requires explicit reviewed Open network policy in Security Lab; this tool never changes settings or starts a server. Install: ffuf.
